\"A mobile design philosophy inspired by the ancestors of this industry, prioritizing utility over decoration. It neither hides complexity behind animations nor overhauls unambiguous functions. By treating your most personal device as an extension of self, it harmonizes everything you do with the needs of the future.\"
A New Way to Organize Your Digital Life

Apps inside this category will not be deleted from your phone. They will be moved to \'Uncategorized\' or return to their original category based on the system\'s logic.
All manual app category moves will be reset to their default categories.
The hub for human connection and real-time dialogue. It prioritizes direct communication and community bonding.
WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Signal, Phone, Contacts, Zoom, Teams.
Essential personal utilities derived from the heritage of mobile tools. These are the basic functions that transformed phones into personal digital assistants.
Calendar, Clock, Calculator, Voice Recorder, Keep, Notes, Translate.
Digital replacements for standalone physical hardware. This category honors the devices that smartphones have successfully unified into a single experience.
Music Players (Walkman/iPod), Camera, Gallery, Google Maps, Yandex Maps, Moovit, Pegasus.
Your gateway to the global network and decentralized storage. It encompasses web exploration, cloud accessibility, and secure connections.
Chrome, Firefox, Google App, Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, VPN, Email clients, obilet.
The commerce and service hub. It represents the transition of the physical marketplace into a digital, on-demand ecosystem.
Play Store, Amazon, Temu, Getir, Yemeksepeti, Trendyol, Hepsiburada, A101, Algida, Hopi.
Professional efficiency and document integrity. A workspace dedicated to formal creation, viewing, and management of business assets.
Word, Excel, Google Docs, Sheets, Slides, PDF Viewers, Adobe Acrobat, Document Scanners.
A temporary space for applications yet to be assigned a specific purpose within the launcher\'s organizational philosophy.
The engine room and ecosystem manager. It controls the device\'s internal logic and the external hardware connected to your digital life.
Settings, Security, Local File Explorers (WinRAR), Smart Home (Huawei AI Life, SmartThings), Wearable Management, Arctis, Speedtest.
High-engagement community interaction and shared digital experiences. These platforms focus on social validation and content sharing.
YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, X (Twitter), Threads, Reddit, TikTok.
Real-time global reporting and broadcast culture. It brings the traditional press and television into the palm of your hand.
Digital Newspapers, News Portals, TV Channels, Haberler, Gazeteler.
The digital playground. Covers the entire spectrum of interactive entertainment, from nostalgic emulations to modern mobile masterpieces.
Steam, Xbox, PlayStation App, PSP/PS2 Emulators, Clash of Clans, SimCity, Roblox, Angry Birds, Chess, Sudoku.
Passive media consumption and cultural access. It focuses on the enjoyment of art, cinema, and live events.
Netflix, Disney+, HBO Max, Amazon Prime Video, Cinema/Theater Tickets, Angel.
Personal and corporate wealth management. A secure environment for monitoring and managing your economic potential.
Banking Apps (GarantiBBVA, İşCep, Yapı Kredi), Stock Market Trackers, Crypto Wallets, Binance, PayPal, BonusFlaş, DövizApp.
Critical information and official gateways. These are the trusted sources for administrative and security-critical data.
e-Devlet, e-Nabız, MHRS, ÖSYM AİS, Password Managers (KeePass, Bitwarden), Authenticators.
The literary and spiritual library. Dedicated to long-form reading, linguistic tools, and religious guidance.
Kindle, Google Books, Dictionaries, Namaz Vakti, Quran, Holy Bible.
The journey of lifelong learning. It includes platforms that facilitate the acquisition of new skills and knowledge.
Udemy, BTK Akademi, LinkedIn Learning, StackOverflow, GitHub, Duolingo.
Professional growth and service acquisition. It bridges the gap between labor supply and professional opportunities.
LinkedIn, Kariyer.net, Yenibiriş, Indeed, Armut, İŞKUR Mobil, Professional Hiring Tools.
Holistic well-being monitoring. It transforms the device into a companion for tracking physical and biological health.
Fitness Coaching, Activity Trackers, Cycle Trackers, Medical Records.
Strategic gaming and competitive league tracking. Focuses on the analysis and participation in sports-based prediction markets.
League Trackers (Maçkolik), Nesine, Misli, Betting Apps.
The center for generative creation. It empowers the user to produce new value using AI and advanced editing tools.
ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Video/Photo Editors (CapCut, Canva), YT Studio, Sketching Tools.
